title: Download selected salesman commission evidence page as Chinese PDF
description: Users download the selected field order and current evidence page as a Chinese PDF from the existing designer. Reuse the same request, pure validation, fresh authorization and bounded source as preview/Excel; dedicated PDF endpoint rebuilds the current page, not client rows/preview cache. Add narrow DynamicSalesCommissionPdfExporter with direct construction by controller using existing PDFsharp and existing local SimHei font resolution; no package/config/font asset writes. Render Chinese headings and signed original-currency numbers, explicit unknowns and distinguish configured numeric zero reference rate from absent/invalid rate. Always print dates/normalized filters/current-page coverage/500-order source cap/source and raw currency grouping/current-reference-rate and unknown historical-profit/payout context even evidence fields hidden. Wide finite columns split across column pages with identity/coverage context; tall pages repeat headers and avoid clipped overlapping text, no unselected detail columns or cross-currency totals. Font unavailable or rendering failure explicitly rejects download, never empty-success or missing-glyph success. Page downloads PDF with current selection/filter/page and shows errors while preserving state. Tests inspect generated PDF bytes/text/page structure where supported and deterministic renderer inputs/layout calculations, not screenshots or real-browser acceptance. Development only. Reuse existing sales-commission menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted SalesOrders and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; each endpoint rechecks identity, menu and fresh scope and validates the current request, failing closed without data/file on revocation, invalid input or source overflow. Salesman filters are order attributes and never expand customer scope. Current parameter rate is reference information, not a historical agreed rate, actual payout, customer agency fee or ledger entry. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint validates current request and rechecks fresh identity/menu/customer scope, rebuilding the same bounded selected page and refusing permission/cap/render failures.
Chinese PDF preserves selected order, signed values and explicit unknowns with mandatory context, paginated wide/tall content and explicit font failures.
Existing page PDF download preserves selected/filter/page state and shows explicit errors; PDF/controller/UI tests plus safe build/test pass without pretending external browser/database acceptance.
